name: SFR Directory Category Display
author: SupportFromRichard

sections.description:
This plugin solves a common issue with many popular directory plugins: category descriptions added in the admin area do not appear on the front end. This often leaves category pages looking incomplete and provides a poor user experience.

SFR Directory Category Display automatically detects and displays these descriptions, along with category images and subcategories, on their respective pages. It works with your existing theme, so no complex configuration is needed.

Supported Plugins:
* Directorist
* Business Directory Plugin
* GeoDirectory

Note: This plugin has been tested for compatibility with the free versions of the supported plugins. It has not yet been formally tested with their premium or paid add-on versions.

Features

  • Category and Tag Descriptions: Automatically displays descriptions on all category and tag pages
  • Image Display: Shows category images on the front end
  • Subcategory Listings: Displays subcategories with icons in grid or list layouts
  • Analytics Dashboard: Track completion status for categories and tags
  • Layout Options: Grid and list view options for subcategory display
  • Theme Compatibility: Theme-friendly styling that works with any theme
  • Clean Uninstall: All plugin data is removed when the plugin is completely deleted from your site

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services. All functionality runs entirely on your WordPress installation.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any user data. All functionality runs locally on your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sfr-directory-category-display/ or install through the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Ensure you have one of these plugins installed: Directorist, Business Directory Plugin, or GeoDirectory.
  4. Visit any category page to see descriptions automatically displayed.
  5. Optionally configure settings under the plugin admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this work with all themes?

Yes, the plugin includes theme-friendly styling that adapts to your theme’s design automatically.

Which directory plugins are supported?

Currently supported:
* Directorist (all versions)
* Business Directory Plugin
* GeoDirectory

The plugin automatically detects which one you’re using.

Is this plugin compatible with the premium versions of the supported directories?

This plugin has been tested for compatibility with the free versions of Directorist, Business Directory Plugin, and GeoDirectory. It may work with their premium versions, but this has not yet been formally tested.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and only loads on category pages where needed.

Do I need to configure anything?

The plugin works automatically after activation. Optional settings are available in the admin menu for layout and display options.

Does it work with tags?

Yes, the plugin displays tag descriptions on tag pages just like category descriptions.

Can I customize the styling?

Yes, the plugin includes layout options and theme-friendly styling that adapts to your theme automatically. The styling is designed to work seamlessly with most WordPress themes without requiring additional customization.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

When you deactivate the plugin, category descriptions will no longer be displayed on the frontend, but all plugin settings and data are preserved. When you reactivate the plugin, everything will work exactly as before. Plugin data is only removed when you completely delete the plugin from your site.

Does it work with custom taxonomies?

Currently, the plugin works with the standard category and tag taxonomies of the supported directory plugins. Custom taxonomies are not yet supported.

Can I exclude certain categories?

Category exclusion is not available in this version.

Where do I get support?

Free support is available through the WordPress support forums at wordpress.org/support/plugin/sfr-directory-category-display/

Is there a Pro/Premium version available?

Yes! SFR Directory Category Display Pro is available with additional features including:
* Advanced style customization options
* Enhanced SEO analytics and reporting
* Priority support
* Multi-site licenses

Learn more at: https://supportfromrichard.co.uk/plugins/sfr-directory-category-display/
